published_ranges._notes: Values are printed as '±' ranges on the official page. Bronze-filled PLA. The page says '80% bronze filling' in the summary and '+/-60% (gravimetrically)' in the feature list. Density 3.5 g/cc is outside the validator range, so it is not in fields; set it manually. Abrasive metal powder: resellers quote 'compatible with >= 0.4mm hardened nozzles', so use a hardened nozzle. Bambu has no metal-filled PLA preset, so Generic PLA is used (not confirmed).
